action.layout_note: piperx has 7 arm/gripper controls; runtime.action_layout is authoritative.

reset.variation: none; seed is provenance only, not a reset randomization input

spec: ball radius 0.025 m, mass 0.10 kg, friction 0.8, start XY (0.60,0.22)
tray base z=0.65 m; default pickup_height=0 m
pot mouth criterion 0.30 m and cavity radius 0.09 m
success/failure rules, 50 Hz, 60 seconds and binary score
episode_instance: initial_state (identical fixed reset state for all 15 attempts)
derived: distance is measured from scenario reference origin, not an offset robot base

rules.grasp: both active-arm fingers contact continuously >=0.1 s at 50 Hz control ticks
rules.lift: grasped AND both fingers contact AND ball center z>tray_z+pickup_height+ball_radius+0.06; default threshold 0.735 m
rules.open_request: lifted AND active gripper action < -0.5; latched after the control step
rules.release: after lift: no active-gripper contact continuously >=0.04 s at control ticks; save first separation sample position and velocity; contact resets separation tracking
rules.legal_release: open requested AND norm(separation-start linear velocity)>=0.2 m/s
rules.inside_pot: relative to actual pot body: -0.02<z<0.275 AND hypot(x,y)<0.065; strict bounds
rules.success: released AND inside_pot AND no active-gripper contact AND speed<0.08 m/s continuously >=0.5 s, with no failure; interrupted hold resets timer
rules.completion_event: ball_settled_in_pot only; grasp/lift/release/entry milestones do not score
failure_checks: confirmed release without open request => ball_slipped
confirmed release with speed<0.2 m/s => released_without_throw
after lifted and open_requested, ball touches tray at any physics substep => platform_contact_after_release (may precede confirmed release)
outside pot AND ball center z<ball_radius+0.01 => ball_dropped, missed_pot or bounced_out
released AND outside pot AND no active-gripper contact AND speed<0.04 m/s continuously >=0.5 s => settled_outside_pot
rules.post_release_gripper_contact: not a standalone failure; contact prevents settling and resets its timer
rules.nonfinite: native reports non_finite_state; unified instance replay marks group invalid and aborts, not a zero-score model failure
rules.score: 100 on success, otherwise 0; reward=1 on success, otherwise 0
rules.horizon: 3000 control steps = 60 simulated seconds; no success/failure by horizon => truncation, score 0
rules.feasibility: no new controller certification or calibration; prior demo certificates remain separate; default random-distance profile is not replaced by the near-calibration demo scenario
